note: Insects with their wing motion as glTF clips, in kit/catalog/assets/<file>, made by export_insects.gd and measured by insects.py record. Never edit by hand.

models.name: small white butterfly
models.description: A small white butterfly, white wings with a dark tip and a black spot; the commonest in the city's gardens. About 9 cm across. Real size: place it at scale 2-3 where it must read from eye height.
models.cite: the iamar browser source (not public) a025eeba scripts/world/butterflies.gd (mesh, SPECIES), scripts/world/butterfly_motion.gd (wing poses), assets/butterflies/atlas.png (tools/make_butterfly_atlas.py); exported by kit/catalog/assets/export_insects.gd

models.name: bumblebee
models.description: A fuzzy bumblebee about 2 cm long, black with two yellow bands and a white tail, clear wings swept back; hovers buzzing over flowers. Real size: place it at scale 2-3 where it must read from eye height.
behaviours: hovering buzz with a bob (clip fly)
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_insects.gd in the city butterflies' build (the city has no bumblebee model: bees are a sound there, MpSoundscape 'bees')

models.name: dragonfly
models.description: An emperor-like dragonfly about 7.5 cm long: big green eyes, green thorax, a long sky-blue abdomen ringed in black, four long clear wings held straight out. Real size: place it at scale 2-3 where it must read from eye height.
behaviours: hovering, fore and hind wings beating out of phase (clip fly)
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_insects.gd in the city butterflies' build (the city has no dragonfly model: dragonflies are glowing motes over the mill pond, Waterworks/Fx.motes)
